items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: I had two, three piano players, Louie Varona, Gilberto [Frank] Ayala, Bellonás, Robert Alila, Joe Loco.

ctx.x: Yeah, colored guy. Bass player, Julio Andino (phonetic). I had two, three piano players, Louie Varona, Gilberto [Frank] Ayala, Bellonás, Robert Alila, Joe Loco.
Joe Loco was in there, wasn't he?
